topic: Riveting and De-riveting: Types of rivets, rivet parameters calculation, standard riveting procedure, de-riveting of loose rivets, heat treatment
syllabus_extract: Riveting and De-riveting: Types of rivets, rivet parameters calculation, standard riveting procedure, de-riveting of loose rivets, heat treatment of rivets, inspection procedure.
specific_objectives: 28.1.3.3 Trainee will be able to explain Riveting and De-riveting, Types of rivets.

training_aids.remarks: Refer to the master syllabus reference list
Objective: teach the syllabus extract for this lesson

practical: Demonstration of rivet parameter calculation and standard riveting procedure on practice panel; Safety: Eye protection, fire watch for heat treatment; Supervision: Instructor monitors tool usage and heat application.
intro_questions: What is the primary purpose of riveting in aircraft structures?
Name two common types of rivet heads used in aviation.
Why is heat treatment required for certain rivet alloys?

development.content:
Classification of rivet types
Rivet parameter calculations
Standard riveting procedure
De-riveting loose rivets
Heat treatment of rivets

Inspection procedure for riveted joints
Common defects in riveting
Safety precautions during heat treatment
Tool maintenance and storage
Quality control checks

topics: Cooling rates for heat treated rivets
development.content:
Review of rivet head deformation
Correct torque application
Cooling rates for heat treated rivets
Documentation of rivet installation
Troubleshooting installation issues

summary_questions: Explain the difference between solid and blind rivets.
Describe the steps involved in the standard riveting procedure.
What are the critical parameters to check during rivet inspection?
home_assignment_question: Prepare a brief report comparing the riveting and patch repair techniques covered in LP 05 and LP 06, highlighting key differences in application.
